_关于本文件: 完整方案的一句话简介。键是 mooncakes 包名，值是 [中文, 英文]。只有「完整方案」需要写，基础库沿用注册表原描述。改完运行 python3 pipeline/analyze.py 重新构建即可，构建日志会列出缺失或对不上的条目。以 _ 开头的键会被忽略，可以当注释用。
_写法约定: 回答三件事：这是什么形态的方案、它替你做了什么决定、什么情况下该选它。不要写「高性能」「强大」这类空话，也不要重复注册表里的描述。
moonbit-community/proton: 类 Electron 的桌面运行时：界面交给内置浏览器承载，可直接复用现有前端生态，托盘、剪贴板、全局热键等系统模块配套齐全。
Electron-style desktop runtime: the UI lives in a built-in webview, so existing frontend code carries over, with tray, clipboard and global-hotkey modules alongside.
wzzc-dev/moui: 自带渲染引擎的跨端 GUI 框架：不依赖系统 WebView，桌面与移动共用一套代码，能覆盖到没有浏览器内核的设备。
Cross-platform GUI framework with its own renderer — no system WebView, one codebase for desktop and mobile, and it reaches devices that have no browser engine.
NoahLiu/native-gui: 纯原生桌面方案：一套代码直出 Windows / Linux / macOS 原生窗口，托盘、通知、快捷键、输入法、开机自启等系统能力开箱即用。
Fully native desktop framework: one codebase produces real Windows / Linux / macOS windows, with tray, notifications, hotkeys, IME and autostart built in.
vectie/lepusa: MoonBit 原生桌面框架的研究性实现，更适合当参考读，而不是直接拿来做产品。
A research implementation of a MoonBit-native desktop framework — better read as a reference than shipped as a product.
Nanaloveyuki/orbit: 组合式桌面基座：原生窗口配系统 WebView，IPC 带策略授权，另附 orbit-cli 工具链，能力按需拼装而不是一次给全。
Composable desktop foundations: native windows plus the system WebView, policy-gated IPC, and an orbit-cli toolchain — capabilities are assembled on demand.
lepus-apps/webview: 以 Web 技术构建桌面的应用框架：界面层完全交给 HTML / CSS，MoonBit 负责窗口、事件和系统调用。
A desktop framework built on web technologies: the UI layer is plain HTML / CSS, while MoonBit owns windows, events and system calls.
tonyfettes/giraffe: Elm 架构的声明式 UI 框架，底层绑定 GTK4，走原生控件路线，Linux 桌面上完成度最高。
Declarative Elm-style UI framework bound to GTK4 — native widgets rather than a webview, most complete on Linux desktops.
XiLaiTL/moobile: 一套 Rabbita（TEA）代码同时出 Android / iOS / Web，渲染交给 React Native，前端团队迁移成本最低。
One Rabbita (TEA) codebase targeting Android / iOS / Web, rendered by React Native — the cheapest path for teams already on React.
lampclaw/minimoon: 面向微信小程序 Skyline 渲染引擎的 UI 运行时：Elm 状态机驱动，局部状态更新是事务性的，宿主命令自动生成。
A UI runtime for WeChat MiniApp's Skyline renderer: Elm-style state machines, transactional local state, and generated host commands.
Magic486/moon-miniprogram: 微信小程序开发框架：类型安全运行时、状态自动 diff、跨页 store、声明式路由，连无头测试基建都带了。
WeChat MiniProgram framework: a type-safe runtime, automatic state diffing, a cross-page store, declarative routing, and headless test infrastructure.
shop1111/moonohos: HarmonyOS 原生模块框架：异步任务、平台模块调用、HAR 打包三件事一次解决。
HarmonyOS native module framework covering async tasks, platform module calls and HAR packaging.
lampclaw/lampo: 小程序 Skyline 的另一条路线：纯 Elm 风格书写，状态按组件隔离，不共享全局 store。
The other Skyline route: purely Elm-style authoring with component-scoped state instead of a global store.
vectie/bunnia: 小程序 UI 框架，按 Rabbita 风格书写，靠可插拔的平台适配层支持多端。
Mini-app UI framework in Rabbita style, using pluggable platform adapters to reach multiple hosts.
moonbit-community/rabbita: 官方函数式 Web UI 框架，Elm 架构（Model-Update-View），生态配套最全，拿不准时选它。
The official functional web UI framework, Elm architecture (Model-Update-View), with the deepest ecosystem — the safe default.
mizchi/luna: 细粒度响应式 UI 库：信号驱动、无虚拟 DOM diff，更新粒度和产物体积都更可控。
Fine-grained reactive UI library: signal-driven with no virtual-DOM diffing, giving you control over update granularity and bundle size.
marianoguerra/tutuca: 工具链最齐的一套：模板语言、虚拟 DOM、组件、运行时、lint、CLI 都在一个包里。
The most complete toolkit of the bunch: template language, virtual DOM, components, runtime, lint and CLI in one package.
Arcelyth/aitne: 轻量响应式 Web 框架，主打运行时开销小，适合内容型页面而不是重交互应用。
A lightweight reactive web framework focused on low runtime cost — good for content pages rather than heavy interaction.
mizchi/tui: 信号驱动的 TUI 库，状态一变自动重绘，适合已经习惯响应式写法的项目。
Signal-driven TUI library that repaints on state change — a natural fit if you already write reactive code.
moonbit-community/rabbita_tui: 官方 Elm 架构终端工具包，和 Rabbita 共用一套心智模型，Web 与终端能沿用同一种组织方式。
The official Elm-architecture terminal toolkit, sharing Rabbita's mental model so web and terminal code stay organized the same way.
Frank-III/onebit-tui: 带 Yoga flexbox 布局引擎的 TUI 库，用 CSS 式的盒模型排版终端界面。
TUI library with a Yoga flexbox engine — lay out terminal UIs with CSS-style box model rules.
moonbitstack/moonetui: 重工业 TUI 工具包：单元格缓冲加差分 ANSI 渲染、增量按键解析、五十个组件和一套类 CSS 设计系统。
A heavy-duty TUI toolkit: cell buffer with differential ANSI rendering, incremental key parsing, fifty widgets and a CSS-like design system.
brickfrog/pippa: Bubble Tea 风格的 TUI 框架，Model-Update-View 加类型化消息，从 Go 生态迁过来最顺手。
Bubble Tea-style TUI framework with Model-Update-View and typed messages — the smoothest transition from Go.
Yoorkin/ArgParser: 最轻的一个：定义命令、选项、子命令就够用，不引入额外依赖。
The lightest option: declare commands, options and subcommands, with no extra dependencies.
mizchi/admiral: 声明式 CLI 构建器（gunshi 风格），把命令结构写成数据，帮助文本和补全自动生成。
Declarative CLI builder in gunshi style: describe the command tree as data and get help text and completion generated.
TheWaWaR/clap: Rust clap 的移植，用法基本对应，写过 clap 的话迁移成本接近零。
A port of Rust's clap with near-identical usage — almost zero migration cost if you've written clap before.
totto2727/admiral: admiral 的异步优先分支，命令处理可以直接返回异步结果。
The async-first fork of admiral, where command handlers can return async results directly.
Milky2018/selene: ECS 架构的游戏引擎，实体-组件-系统分层清晰，适合逻辑复杂、要长期加内容量的项目。
An ECS game engine with a clean entity-component-system split — suited to projects with complex logic and long content roadmaps.
mizchi/kagura: 2D 优先的游戏引擎（Ebiten 风格），简单循环加精灵绘制，做小游戏上手最快。
A 2D-first engine in Ebiten style: a simple loop plus sprite drawing, the quickest start for small games.
sssssurf/abyssal_chord: 卡牌对战专用引擎，回合、牌库、结算流程都内置了，附带 CLI 演示。
A card-battle engine with turns, deck and resolution flow built in, plus a CLI demo.
sacckey/moon8bit: 复古 2D 引擎：资源用文本描述、运行时确定性可复现，适合快速迭代和人机协作生成内容。
Retro 2D engine with text-authored assets and a deterministic runtime — built for fast iteration and machine-assisted content.
firefly/firefly: Firefly Zero 掌机的游戏 SDK，目标平台是那台小设备，不是通用桌面。
The SDK for Firefly Zero handhelds — the target is that specific device, not general desktop.
sennenki/reisen: 视觉小说引擎，按剧本、立绘、分支推进，不是通用游戏框架。
A visual novel engine driven by script, artwork and branching — not a general-purpose game framework.
moonbitlang/moonback: 官方 Web 后端框架，路由、中间件、请求响应抽象齐备，生态项目默认拿它当底座。
The official web backend framework with routing, middleware and request/response abstractions — the default base for ecosystem projects.
mizchi/mars: Hono 风格的 Web 框架：trie 路由、中间件、SSE，HTTP 后端走 mizchi/x，原生和 Node.js 都能跑。
Hono-style framework with trie routing, middleware and SSE, running on mizchi/x HTTP for both native and Node.js.
oboard/mocket: 通用 Web 框架，路由与中间件齐备，接口风格接近 Express。
A general web framework with routing and middleware, in an Express-like style.
bobzhang/crescent: Web 框架，出自 MoonBit 语言作者之手，实现偏探索性质，适合读代码而不是直接上生产。
A web framework from MoonBit's own author — more exploratory than production-ready, worth reading as much as using.
jaredzhou/pony: 轻量 HTTP 框架与路由器（Go 的 Chi 风格），只需要路由和中间件时用它。
Lightweight HTTP framework and router in Chi style — reach for it when all you need is routing and middleware.
RabitLogic/mbit: Gin 风格的 Web 框架，API 设计和 Go 生态高度对应，从 Gin 迁过来几乎不用重新学。
Gin-style web framework whose API maps closely to Go's ecosystem — almost no relearning from Gin.
moonbitstack/moonapi: 类型化 Web 框架：路由、参数、响应都纳入类型检查，把错误挡在编译期。
A typed web framework that puts routes, params and responses under type checking, moving errors to compile time.
daqing/moonway: 全栈 Web 框架，前后端在同一个工程里组织，不用拆两套构建。
A full-stack framework keeping frontend and backend in one project instead of two build pipelines.
wflixu/Halo: Koa 洋葱模型的中间件框架，支持结构化并发和流式响应，重中间件编排的服务适合它。
Koa-style onion middleware with structured concurrency and streaming responses — good for services built around middleware composition.
kupas/express: Express 兼容的 Web 框架，底层走 uWebSockets，从 Node 迁过来改动最小。
Express-compatible framework backed by uWebSockets — the smallest diff when porting from Node.
KKKIIO/moondark: Django 风格的后端框架，建在 moonback 之上，自带工程结构的约定。
Django-inspired backend framework built on moonback, with opinions about project structure.
moonbitstack/moonzero: 服务框架，面向服务拆分而不是单机 HTTP 应用，边界比 Web 框架高一层。
A service framework aimed at splitting services rather than serving a single HTTP app — one level above a web framework.
anccnuer/onho: Hono 风格的轻量 Web 框架，路由和中间件刚好够用。
A lightweight Hono-style web framework with just enough routing and middleware.
moonbitstack/moondb: 数据库访问的标准接口层：定义驱动与查询层的契约，本身不实现任何数据库。对应 Go 的 database/sql、Python 的 DB-API，想让上层代码不绑死某个数据库时用它。

The standard database access interface: it defines the driver/query-layer contract without implementing any database. MoonBit's counterpart to Go's database/sql or Python's DB-API — use it to keep upper layers from binding to one engine.
oboard/morm: 轻量 ORM：类型化查询加代码生成，支持多种数据库引擎，接口克制。
Lightweight ORM with typed queries and code generation across several engines, keeping the API small.
moonbitstack/moonorm: ORM 与 SQL 工具包，模型映射和查询构建都在同一套里。
An ORM plus SQL toolkit covering both model mapping and query building.
wflixu/Orion: Derive 加代码生成的 ORM：用 Schema DSL 描述表，自动产出类型安全 CRUD 和查询构建器。
A derive-and-codegen ORM: describe tables in a schema DSL and get type-safe CRUD plus a query builder generated.
zen314/shadow: 简单 ORM，接口直白，中小项目起步够用。
A simple ORM with a straightforward API — enough to get a small project moving.
moonbitlang/async: 官方异步库，协程调度加 IO 抽象，生态里的默认底座，其他库大多兼容它。
The official async library with coroutine scheduling and IO abstractions — the ecosystem default that most other libraries build on.
peter-jerry-ye/async: Promise、事件循环、IO 三件套的异步库，接口偏 JS 习惯。
Async library offering promises, an event loop and IO, with an API shaped like JavaScript.
didiLjf/moonorbit: Actor 并发框架，用消息传递代替共享状态，适合状态多、并发写冲突多的服务。
An actor concurrency framework that replaces shared state with message passing — useful where concurrent writes contend.
kalculos/miao: 以 libuv 为默认运行时的异步 IO 库，行为和 Node 生态最接近。
Async IO library backed by libuv as its default runtime, behaving closest to the Node ecosystem.
Yu-zh/data: serde 形态的序列化框架：一套数据模型，多种格式共用同一套序列化逻辑，换格式不用重写。
A serde-shaped serialization framework: one data model shared across formats, so switching format doesn't mean rewriting.
chensuiyi/bm2: 给 Bun / Node.js 应用用的 Linux 进程管理器，本身用 MoonBit 写。
A Linux process manager for Bun / Node.js apps, itself written in MoonBit.
mizchi/actrun: 兼容 GitHub Actions 的本地 CI runner，workflow 能在自己机器上跑，不必等远端。
A local CI runner compatible with GitHub Actions, so workflows run on your own machine instead of waiting on a remote.
kupas/pm3: PM2 式的语言无关进程管理器，内置日志轮转，跑什么语言的进程都行。
A PM2-like, language-agnostic process manager with built-in log rotation.
tiye/redstart: 面向本地开发的轻量进程管理器，一次起停一组服务。
A lightweight process manager for local development that starts and stops a group of services together.
colmugx/posoco: 六边形架构（端口-适配器）的 Agent 框架：定义扩展端口和 Agent 循环，LLM 供应商与工具都可替换。
A hexagonal (ports-and-adapters) agent framework: extension ports and an agent loop, with LLM providers and tools swappable.
colmugx/mcp: 类型安全的 MCP SDK，服务端客户端都有，STDIO 和 HTTP 两种传输都支持。
A type-safe MCP SDK covering both server and client, over STDIO or HTTP transports.
golemcloud/golem_sdk: Golem 平台的 SDK，用来构建可持久化、故障自恢复的 agent，代价是绑定到这个托管平台。
The SDK for the Golem platform, for durable and fault-tolerant agents — at the cost of depending on that hosted platform.
weopqrst/agent: LangChain 核心库的 MoonBit 版：类型安全、可组合、可嵌入，LLM 客户端走 mizchi/llm。
The MoonBit take on LangChain's core: type-safe, composable and embeddable, with LLM clients coming from mizchi/llm.
soehi/moonlm: 本地 LLM 推理引擎加强类型 agent 运行时，不依赖外部 API 也能跑模型。
A local LLM inference engine plus a strongly-typed agent runtime — models run without calling an external API.
moonbitlang/yacc: 官方 LR(1) 语法分析器生成器，写文法出解析器，适合整门语言的完整语法。
The official LR(1) parser generator: write a grammar, get a parser — suited to a full language grammar.
cogna-dev/parkit: nom 风格的解析器组合子框架，用函数组合拼解析逻辑，适合局部格式而不是整门语言。
A nom-style parser combinator framework that assembles parsing from composed functions — for local formats rather than whole languages.
moonbitlang/quickcheck: 官方 QuickCheck 实现：用属性描述行为，自动生成输入去找反例。
The official QuickCheck: describe behavior as properties and let generated inputs hunt for counterexamples.
moonrockz/moonspec: BDD 测试框架，支持 Gherkin 语法和 Cucumber 表达式，需求文档可以直接变成测试。
A BDD framework supporting Gherkin and Cucumber expressions, so requirement documents can turn into tests.
aspnmy/moonitest: 集成测试框架，通过真实 Docker / TCP / HTTP 打后端接口，是单元测试的补充而不是替代。
An integration testing framework that hits real Docker / TCP / HTTP backends — a complement to unit tests, not a replacement.
Duckweed/moon-proof: 文档示例的持续验证框架：把文档里的代码块抽出来隔离编译运行，回答「文档里的例子还都对吗」。
Continuous verification for documentation examples: extract code blocks, compile and run them in isolation, and answer whether the docs still work.
Milky2018/wasmoon: WebAssembly 运行时：自带 JIT 和解释器，支持 WASI 与 Component Model，可以在 MoonBit 里加载并执行 wasm 模块。
A WebAssembly runtime with its own JIT and interpreter, supporting WASI and the Component Model — load and execute wasm modules from MoonBit.
